items.title: Bennie Turner Interview, 1972-02-09
items.q: Big Heavis, you might know him. He used to play Sousa for him.

ctx.x: Yeah. Did you name the drummer? Yeah, Alfred Williams. After the birthday of the drummer. And then Charlie left the band and went to California and we had John Porter. Big Heavis, you might know him. He used to play Sousa for him. He died and Wilford died, William Warner died, and Alfred died and that was the end of the
band. So what year did you go into service, you said? That was in 43.
